body:
A reader writes:

 In addition to being a local church pastor in the United Methodist Church, I am an Air National Guard Chaplain currently serving on a 366 day deployment. One of the books I brought with me is, “We Make the Road by Walking.”

 THANK YOU!!! The finest devotional/Bible Study I have ever read. Wow…what an outstanding book.

 Thank you for the blessing that you are.

 Thanks for your encouraging words, and may your deployment be safe and full of opportunities for ministry!
